authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/novation/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/novation/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the guide's MIDI parameter table, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the manual prints no Device Inquiry reply.
The instrument sends and reads only the NRPN LSB; the manual says to assume an MSB of 0, which CEditor sends.
Not a parameter here, part of the NRPN messages or ignored: CC 0, CC 6, CC 98, CC 99.
Not a parameter here, not used (`—-`): CC 4, CC 38, CC 39, CC 66, CC 86, CC 96, CC 97, CC 100, CC 101, CC 113.
Not a parameter here, Bank Select, part of preset recall: CC 32.

Not a parameter here, a packed parameter, several settings in one value's bits: CC 65 (ENVELOPE MONO MULTI MODES), CC 67 (UNISON / VOICE TYPE / FILTER TYPE), CC 71 (OSC 1,2,3 OCTAVE / OSC 1>2 SYNC), CC 78 (LFO DELAY MONO MULTI MODE), CC 79 (LFO 1,2 KEYSYNC / LOCK / ONE-SHOT), CC 89 (ARPEGGIATOR CONTROL), NRPN 0:21 (EFFECTS TYPE CONTROL), NRPN 0:22 (EFFECTS GLOBAL SYNC CONTROL), NRPN 0:23 (AUDIO INPUT CONTROL), NRPN 0:25 (EFFECT TYPE SELECTOR/KEYBOARD OCTAVE), NRPN 0:26 (OSC, SOURCE, PW, LFO SELECTORS).
Not a parameter here, a channel mode message: CC 120, CC 121, CC 122, CC 123, CC 124, CC 125, CC 126, CC 127.
